The page stops being narrower than the bar above it

Not a drawing — these are screenshots of the real platform at 1670 px, the width Islam works at, with the cap on and off. Nothing else is changed.

The navigation already escapes the cap and the page does not. The destination row was let past it deliberately (§93.9: a navigation bar is chrome, not content), so today it runs edge to edge at 1655 px while the page under it sits at 1132 px, centred, with 238 px of nothing down each side. That gap is what reads as broken.

Setup pages were widened a week ago and the rest were not. §93.9 answered the same complaint for the railed pages by widening them to 1600 px. This finishes the job and drops the ceiling: the page fills the window.

The screen Islam sent. The deliverables table is squeezed into 920 px, so row 3 wraps onto two lines and one fewer row fits on screen.

Setup → People register

Already widened in §93.9 — this is what the rest of the platform is catching up with.

The rail keeps its width; every pixel goes to the pane, where the measures and tactics are.

The one real cost, and it is not at this width. 1180 px was chosen as a reading measure — prose has an optimum line length. At 1670 px the longest line on a unit's Foundation goes from 483 to 732 px, which is still comfortable. On a 2560 px monitor it reaches 1166 px, which is too long to read easily. The Knowledge base is unaffected — it already carries its own measure.

So: this is the right answer for the screens the platform is actually used on, and if it is ever run on a 32-inch monitor the fix is to give the few prose blocks their own measure — a small change, and not one worth making before it is needed.

What I need a yes on

1 · The 1180 px cap comes off every page. The content fills the window, keeping the 24 px gutters it already has.

2 · The 1600 px ceiling added for Setup pages comes off with it, so there is one behaviour and not two.

3 · Nothing else moves — no spacing, no type, no colours. Only the width the page is allowed to use.
